change_summary: Research-only key-number 3/7 discrete NFL margin challenger beside frozen v3. Adds finite numeric and odds/probability gates, an explicit source-clock as-of training interface, and adversarial synthetic tests; no production pricing changes.
assumptions: Original single-season 68/68 zero-mean exact-margin replay is exploratory and is not a pregame projection comparison.
Unstamped fit_weights is exploratory; fit_weights_asof enforces supplied final/result-capture timestamps before an as-of clock but does NOT independently authenticate those timestamps.
No real book odds, prospective graded wagers, or validated edge is established; frozen v3 and original historical records remain untouched.

baseline.metric: NFL key-number challenger versus frozen v3 on source-authenticated pregame spread results
baseline.unit: paired held-out original-line logloss or Brier
